description: This file contains unit tests for the ChatMarkdownPreprocessor component of the OpenClawChatUI project. The tests verify correct markdown preprocessing behavior, including image extraction, metadata stripping, and handling of specialized markdown constructs.

classes.name: ChatMarkdownPreprocessorTests
classes.description: A test suite struct containing multiple unit tests for the ChatMarkdownPreprocessor.

methods.name: extractsDataURLImages
methods.description: Verifies that data URL images are correctly extracted and cleaned from markdown.

methods.name: flattensRemoteMarkdownImagesIntoText
methods.description: Tests that remote markdown images are flattened into plain text, with images extracted.

methods.name: usesFallbackTextForUnlabeledRemoteMarkdownImages
methods.description: Checks that unlabeled remote images default to a placeholder text.

methods.name: handlesUnicodeBeforeRemoteMarkdownImages
methods.description: Ensures unicode characters preceding images are preserved correctly.

methods.name: stripsInboundUntrustedContextBlocks
methods.description: Verifies removal of inbound untrusted metadata JSON blocks.

methods.name: stripsSingleConversationInfoBlock
methods.description: Tests removal of individual conversation info JSON block.

methods.name: stripsAllKnownInboundMetadataSentinels
methods.description: Checks that all known inbound metadata headers are stripped from markdown.

methods.name: preservesNonMetadataJsonFence
methods.description: Ensures JSON code fences not marked as metadata are preserved intact.

methods.name: stripsLeadingTimestampPrefix
methods.description: Validates truncation of timestamp prefixes in messages.

methods.name: stripsEnvelopeHeadersAndMessageIdHints
methods.description: Verifies removal of envelope headers like message IDs and timestamps.

methods.name: stripsTrailingUntrustedContextSuffix
methods.description: Ensures suffixes indicating untrusted context are stripped.

methods.name: preservesUntrustedContextHeaderWhenItIsUserContent
methods.description: Tests that untrusted context headers with user content are preserved.
